title: 3000V Electric Rechargeable Swatter Mosquito Fly Killer And Bug Zapper Racket UK
body_html:
Features
Dual-Mode Design – Two Uses in One
Electric Swatter Mode: Push the switch up to the 1st gear, then press and hold the power button to activate. Delivers high voltage for efficient mosquito killing. Equipped with a protective mesh for long-lasting performance.
Mosquito Trap Mode: Push the switch up to the 2nd gear to activate the trap mode. Features 18 LED beads emitting 365–390nm blue-violet light, combined with variable frequency broadcasting technology to attract mosquitoes toward the high-voltage grid. Automatic trapping with quiet operation for a peaceful sleep.

3,000V High-Voltage Grid – Instant Kill
This electric mosquito swatter is equipped with a 3,000V high-voltage grid. Press the power button to instantly kill flies, mosquitoes, and other flying insects. In trap mode, the specific wavelength of UV light continuously lures mosquitoes to the high-voltage grid, where they are zapped instantly.

Type-C Charging + Smart Digital Display – Battery Status at a Glance
Built-in 1200mAh rechargeable battery – no disposable batteries needed, for longer runtime. Type-C USB port enables fast and convenient charging. The smart digital display shows remaining battery level clearly.

Lightweight & Portable – Clear View at Night
Lightweight and comfortable to hold. The mosquito trap mode allows hands‑free operation, suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Equipped with a high‑brightness LED search light for night illumination or precise mosquito hunting in the dark.

Three‑Layer Safety Protection – Worry‑Free Use
Three-layer protective mesh – the two outer layers carry no current for safer use. Built‑in high‑quality circuit protection prevents overcharging, over‑discharging, and short circuits. After powering off, residual electricity in the high‑voltage grid is automatically discharged. Note: Do not insert your hand into the protective mesh while the device is powered on.



Specifications
Type: Electric mosquito swatter / mosquito trap
Material: ABS
Color: White
Runtime (trap mode): approx. 2 hours
Charging time: approx. 3 hours
Rotation angle: 180°
Charging: Type‑C USB cable
Main unit size: 21.9 × 3 × 52.5 cm
Base diameter: 11 × 3 cm
Voltage: 3,000V
Power: 3.5W
Battery: 18650 lithium battery
Features: Rotating, telescopic, foldable electric swatter
Use scenarios: Daytime swatter mode, nighttime trap mode, watching TV in the living room, parties, bedroom sleeping



Important Notes
Do not leave the automatic mode on for extended periods.
Do not place the swatter in high‑temperature environments while it is operating.



Package Included
1 × Electric mosquito swatter
1 × Electric mosquito swatter base
1 × Type-C charging cable
1 × English instruction manual
